# axm mcps

Manage MCP server extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when configuring MCP servers for supported agents.

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Add an MCP server from the registry**

```bash
axm mcps install @acme/mcps/my-server
```

**Remove an MCP server**

```bash
axm mcps uninstall my-server
```

**Bump an MCP server version**

```bash
axm mcps version @acme/mcps/my-server patch
```

## Subcommands

| Command                              | Summary                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [axm mcps install](mcps/install)     | Reinstall configured MCP servers from their sources, or install an MCP server from a registry |
| [axm mcps uninstall](mcps/uninstall) | Uninstall an MCP server                                                                       |
| [axm mcps list](mcps/list)           | List installed MCP servers                                                                    |
| [axm mcps enable](mcps/enable)       | Enable a disabled MCP server                                                                  |
| [axm mcps disable](mcps/disable)     | Disable an MCP server                                                                         |
| [axm mcps update](mcps/update)       | Update MCP servers                                                                            |
| [axm mcps new](mcps/new)             | Create a new MCP server                                                                       |
| [axm mcps publish](mcps/publish)     | Publish an MCP server                                                                         |
| [axm mcps version](mcps/version)     | Bump a managed MCP server manifest version                                                    |

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
